Subject: The Beacon headlamp: 400 lumens, 40 hours, 95 grams
Preview: Enough light for the long push out. No extra weight to carry in.
Body: When the trail runs longer than the daylight, you want a headlamp that doesn't make you think about it.

The Northbay Beacon puts out 400 lumens — enough to read terrain confidently at night — and runs up to 40 hours on a charge. That covers a multi-day trip without rationing your light.

It charges over USB-C, so the same cable you use for everything else works here. At 95 grams, it sits on your head without reminding you it's there.

The Beacon is built for backpacking, trail running, and camp use. It is not rated for technical caving or extended submersion.

Now available.
